Two orchestrator modules exist: execution_orchestrator.py and executor_pipeline.py. verify.py routes both 'execute', 'execution-plan', 'execution-status', 'execution-report' through execution_orchestrator and 'evidence-plan', 'evidence-execute', 'evidence-reconcile', 'evidence-certify' through executor_pipeline. Need to verify they are not duplicating authority.
Already known from M46.0: orchestrator is NOT wired into the canonical path. Architectural dead-end.

All new capabilities will integrate into the existing verify.py + executor_pipeline + mutation_runner + strengthening_pipeline stack.
no_new_framework_decision.evidence: 76 verification modules already exist; consolidation > creation
